Surfaces register destinations via window.ZoomAcross.register({id,label,available,launch}); first = BIM Viewer (C_Project BIM band PK>=990000 → open the building scene, ../viewer/viewer.html?db=../buildings/<Value>_extracted.db&bld=<Value>). §AD-GATE showWhen:zoom-across — surfaces when ANY destination is available (IdmpPillZoomGate); off otherwise so the iDempiere chrome stays pure. pills.name: Plugin Engine
pills.note: PLUGIN_SYSTEM_LANE.md §Phase D — the Fold-Engine plugin host (W-PLUGIN). TAP opens PluginEngine.open: paste a raw ES-module bundle URL → one click → ACTIVE (collapses iDempiere's drop-JAR-restart + 2Pack-import into one in-surface action). A bundle contributes into the live engine registries (AdModelVal/AdCallout/AdProcess/PostResolver) via plugin_registry.js; state persists in IndexedDB. plug glyph (Lucide verbatim). NEVER stage-gated (engine plugins are a global concern). §-witness §PLUGIN-PILL.

pills.name: Sound FX
pills.note: The SAME Sound-FX speaker pill as the BIM viewer (panels.js id=audio, key v) — idempiere.html loads ../viewer/sfx.js so window.toggleSfx + window.__sfx are present. TAP toggles the ERP/POS earcons (POS ring/pay/complete, §R2-AUDIO); lit when on (IdmpPillActive.audio → __sfx.isOn()), live-synced via builder.sync(). The choice PERSISTS (localStorage sfx_on overrides erp/sfx.json master.enabled), so a mute sticks across reloads — surfaces the control instead of an invisible default. volume2 glyph (Lucide verbatim, already in icons.js). [[feedback_pill_icon_consistency]].
